title: Keto Caramel Cherry Pilaf with Kissed Flavor
description: A unique and delicious pilaf dish that combines the flavors of caramel, cherry, and kissed with the comfort of malaysian pilaf. This keto-friendly dish is perfect for a low-carb diet.

ingredients.name: caramel
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a sugar-free caramel syrup

ingredients.name: almond flour
ingredients.notes: Optional, but helps to thicken the dish

instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, heat the ghee over medium heat.
2. Add the cherry and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
3. Add the malaysian pilaf to the saucepan and stir to combine.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the caramel syrup and almond flour (if using).
5. Pour the caramel mixture over the pilaf and cherry mixture, stirring to combine.
6. Season with kissed salt to taste.
